642:         unpool = self.unpool(x, indices)
643:         concat_max = torch.maximum(unpool, out_block)
644:         out_block = super(CompetitiveDecoderBlock, self).forward(concat_max)

649: class OutputDenseBlock(nn.Module):
650:     """
651:     Dense Output Block = (Upinterpolated + Skip Connection) --> Semi Competitive Dense Block.
652: 
653:     Attributes
654:     ----------
655:     conv0, conv1, conv2, conv3
656:         Convolution layers.
657:     gn0, gn1, gn2, gn3, gn4
658:         Normalization layers.
659:     prelu
660:         PReLU activation layer.
661: 
662:     Methods
663:     -------
664:     forward
665:         Feed forward trough graph.
666:     """
667: 
668:     def __init__(self, params: dict):
669:         """
670:         Construct OutputDenseBlock object.
671: 
672:         Parameters
673:         ----------
674:         params : dict
675:             Parameters like number of channels, stride etc.
676:         """
677:         super(OutputDenseBlock, self).__init__()
678: 
679:         # Padding to get output tensor of same dimensions
680:         padding_h = int((params["kernel_h"] - 1) / 2)
681:         padding_w = int((params["kernel_w"] - 1) / 2)
682: 
683:         # Sub-layer output sizes for BN; and
684:         conv0_in_size = int(params["num_channels"])  # num_channels
685:         conv1_in_size = int(params["num_filters"])
686:         conv2_in_size = int(params["num_filters"])
687: 
688:         # Define the learnable layers
689:         self.conv0 = nn.Conv2d(
690:             in_channels=conv0_in_size,
691:             out_channels=params["num_filters"],
692:             kernel_size=(params["kernel_h"], params["kernel_w"]),
693:             stride=params["stride_conv"],
694:             padding=(padding_h, padding_w),
695:         )
696: 
697:         self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(
698:             in_channels=conv1_in_size,
699:             out_channels=params["num_filters"],
700:             kernel_size=(params["kernel_h"], params["kernel_w"]),
701:             stride=params["stride_conv"],
702:             padding=(padding_h, padding_w),
703:         )
704: 
705:         self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(
706:             in_channels=conv1_in_size,
707:             out_channels=params["num_filters"],
708:             kernel_size=(params["kernel_h"], params["kernel_w"]),
709:             stride=params["stride_conv"],
710:             padding=(padding_h, padding_w),
711:         )
712: 
713:         # D \times D convolution for the last block
714:         self.conv3 = nn.Conv2d(
715:             in_channels=conv2_in_size,
716:             out_channels=params["num_filters"],
717:             kernel_size=(params["kernel_h"], params["kernel_w"]),
718:             stride=params["stride_conv"],
719:             padding=(padding_h, padding_w),
720:         )
721: 
722:         self.gn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(conv1_in_size)
723:         self.gn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(conv2_in_size)
724:         self.gn3 = nn.BatchNorm2d(conv2_in_size)
725:         self.gn4 = nn.BatchNorm2d(conv2_in_size)
726: 
727:         self.prelu = nn.PReLU()  # Learnable ReLU Parameter
728: 
729:     def forward(self, x: Tensor, out_block: Tensor) -> Tensor:
730:         """
731:         Feed forward trough Output block.
732: 
733:         * Maxout combination of unpooled map from previous block + skip connection
734:         * Forwarding toward CompetitiveDenseBlock
735: 
736:         Parameters
737:         ----------
738:         x : Tensor
739:             Up-interpolated input feature map from lower block (gets maxed with out_block).
740:         out_block : Tensor
741:             Skip connection feature map from the corresponding Encoder.
742: 
743:         Returns
744:         -------
745:         out
746:             Processed feature maps.
747:         """
748:         # Concatenation along channel (different number of channels from decoder and skip connection)
749:         concat = torch.cat((x, out_block), dim=1)
750: 
751:         # Activation from pooled input
752:         x0 = self.prelu(concat)
753: 
754:         # Convolution block1 (no maxout here), could optionally add dense connection; 3x3
755:         x0 = self.conv0(x0)
756:         x1_gn = self.gn1(x0)
757:         x1 = self.prelu(x1_gn)
758: 
759:         # Convolution block2; 5x5
760:         x1 = self.conv1(x1)
761:         x2_gn = self.gn2(x1)
762: 
763:         # First Maxout
764:         x2_max = torch.maximum(x1_gn, x2_gn)
765: 
766:         x2 = self.prelu(x2_max)
767:         # Convolution block3; 7x7
768:         x2 = self.conv2(x2)
769:         x3_gn = self.gn3(x2)
770: 
771:         # Second Maxout
772:         x3_max = torch.maximum(x3_gn, x2_max)
773: 
774:         x3 = self.prelu(x3_max)
775:         # Convolution block 4; 9x9
776:         out = self.conv3(x3)
777:         out = self.gn4(out)
778: 
779:         return out
